decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a range of speakers from high-end home units like the Sony SRS-RA3000 to budget-friendly waterproof options like the EDUPLINK and INSMY. While the JBL Charge 4 offered good brand value, I am generally hesitant to purchase refurbished electronics for a primary device. The Sony model is high-quality but quite expensive for a stationary unit, and the more affordable portable options (EDUPLINK, INSMY) had mixed reviews regarding sound quality and longevity. Additionally, the product feed contained many accessories like cases and wall shelves, which limited the pool of viable high-performance speakers. I've decided to hold off on a purchase for now.
